full_judgment: Mr. Morshed also submits that the R.S Khatian having a presumptive value and in the said khatian the status of the predecessors of the plaintiffs having shown as holder of the intermediately interest and as there was no materials to rebut the said presumption, the High Court Division acted illegally in making the Rule absolute without arriving at a finding regarding status of the predecessor of the plaintiffs.
